paragraphs.text: Minimalist color themes for DeepSeek Harness. Pick one with a single click — it's just another plugi
nimalist color themes for DeepSeek Harness. Pick one with a single click — it's just another plugin.
DSH Minimalist Themes is a collection of warm-color themes for Deepseek Harness, designed with a min
mes is a collection of warm-color themes for Deepseek Harness, designed with a minimalist aesthetic.
From the main screen, select **Plugins**. On the Plugins page, select **DSH Minimalist Themes** to o
pen its detail page, then use the theme picker to choose a palette. Select a swatch to apply it; cho
ose the reset option to return to the built-in theme preference. The app-wide Light, Dark, or System
setting is separate and remains under **Settings → General → Appearance**.
The plugin targets the DSH web profile. It was checked against the local Deepseek Harness client bui
ld metadata `0.2.2-alpha.3`; this identifies the local repository/build metadata and does not indepe
ndently verify a separately installed application binary.
Once the plugin is installed, open **Plugins** from the main screen and select **DSH Minimalist Them
es** to access its theme picker.
